entities.name: Srđan Kalember
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Srđan Kalember, also known in France by his nickname Serge, was a Serbian professional basketball player and coach. He won 9 National Championships with Crvena zvezda. He represented the Yugoslavia national basketball team internationally.
